$description: Single registry of source identity used by the generated-mode rules in schema/semantic_validate.py. Two identities exist: the ORIGINAL commercial product the clone was measured from, and the REFERENCE clone's own placeholder identity. Generated pages may contain neither. The original's marketing copy, testimonials and reviewer names are stored ONLY as salted SHA-256 fingerprints (normalised text, whole block + 6-word shingles) computed at build time from the saved original page; no source copy is reproduced in this repository.

evidence.expect: # WeekSync landing page: clone build spec

referenceBrand.role: the clone's own original placeholder identity (allowed in reference mode, blocked in generated mode)

copyFingerprints.algorithm: sha256('design-repo-fp-v1|' + normalised)[:24]; normalised = lowercase, non-alphanumerics collapsed to one space; whole text block when >= 4 words, plus every 6-word shingle

evidence.expect: Write your own marketing copy with these lengths:

personFingerprints.note: real testimonial authors of the original (from its visually-hidden review markup); hashed, never stored as text

referencePeople.note: names already present in the reference clone source; generated pages must invent their own fictional people

urlFingerprints.note: the original's social/contact profile URLs (personal handles), hashed

placeholderDomains.rule: generated mode: every absolute URL host (and mailto domain) must end in one of these reserved suffixes (RFC 2606)

ratingNote: Neither the original nor the clone shows any rating; any rating in a generated page would be a fabricated claim.
